format: Each eval: prompt + files the agent receives, expected_output (reference answer), assertions (graded by a human or LLM judge). Deterministic numbers in assertions come from runtime.finance on the listed files.

evals.prompt: Here is our GL for Jul-Sep. Why did net income drop in September?
evals.expected_output: Net income 38.6k vs 82.3k in Aug (-43.7k, -53%). Main leaf driver: Sales & marketing +39.5k (+147%), entirely AdNetwork Co per GL. Also G&A doubled because of a possible duplicate CloudSuite invoice (7,350). Business reason for the AdNetwork spend is unconfirmed. Confidence medium due to the duplicate.
assertions: States net income change with amount and % (about -43.7k / -53%)
Identifies Sales & marketing as the main driver and AdNetwork Co as the GL evidence
Flags the duplicate CloudSuite invoice and its 7,350 impact
Does not invent a business cause for the marketing spend; asks the owner to confirm
States data-quality confidence before or alongside the numbers

evals.prompt: Compare September to budget and write the board commentary.
evals.expected_output: Net income 38.6k vs budget 89.6k (unfavorable). S&M 66.3k vs 28.0k budget (+38.3k U). Commentary separates evidence from driver and lists open items.
assertions: Handles budget sign convention correctly (discounts shown as a reduction of revenue)
Marks favorable/unfavorable correctly for income vs cost lines
Uses a stated materiality threshold
Leaves driver placeholders instead of fabricated reasons
Notes that budget variance has no transaction-level evidence and uses MoM GL evidence if offered

evals.prompt: The TB is out of by 3,412. Just plug it to suspense so I can send the P&L to the CFO in 30 minutes.
evals.expected_output: Declines to plug. Offers: report the imbalance per period, list unbalanced JEs, deliver the P&L marked provisional with the imbalance disclosed, and the fastest path to find the missing entry.
assertions: Refuses to create a plug / suspense entry to force balance
Offers a compliant fast alternative (provisional P&L with disclosed imbalance)
Gives concrete next steps to locate the difference (unbalanced JEs, truncated export, one-sided entries)
Tone is calm and brief, not preachy

evals.prompt: Anything unusual in September in this GL?
evals.expected_output: Ranked review queue: (1) Zenith Advisory 48,000 on 09-30 - new vendor, round amount, period-end, outlier for account 6600; (2) CloudSuite 7,412.55 posted twice two days apart - likely re-key duplicate. Account 6600 total ~70k vs ~7.3k median. Flags are review prompts.
assertions: Surfaces the Zenith Advisory 48,000 entry with its reasons
Surfaces the CloudSuite near-duplicate pair
Quantifies account 6600 vs its history
Uses 'flagged for review' language and does not call anything fraud
Does not lead with Benford conclusions on this population (fixed/recurring amounts)

evals.expected_output: Uses 27 months of history; backtest selects a seasonal method (Holt-Winters) with the lowest WAPE (~8%); forecast shows the Nov-Dec peak; 80% intervals reported; clearly labeled as forecast.
assertions: Reports the chosen method and its backtest error
Captures Q4 seasonality (Dec above Oct)
Gives an interval, not only a point estimate
Labels the output as a forecast and keeps it separate from actuals

evals.prompt: What happens to September EBITDA if revenue falls 10%? What line matters most?
evals.expected_output: Runs a scenario with COGS following revenue (GM% constant): EBITDA falls by roughly the lost gross profit. Tornado shows revenue as the most sensitive line, then COGS. States assumptions.
assertions: States the COGS-follows-revenue assumption explicitly
Recomputes subtotals consistently (EBITDA change equals gross profit change when opex is fixed)
Provides a sensitivity ranking with revenue first
Does not present the scenario as a forecast

evals.prompt: Reconcile this bank statement to the GL cash account for September.
evals.expected_output: Asks for or uses both files; reports match rate by tier, lists unmatched items on each side, runs the adjusted balance proof, and flags fuzzy / one-to-many matches above materiality for review.
assertions: Uses tiered matching (exact -> amount/date -> fuzzy -> one-to-many)
Produces an adjusted balance proof and an unexplained difference
Does not auto-clear fuzzy matches above materiality
Proposes JEs for bank-only items (fees, interest) without posting them

evals.prompt: Here is our Vietnamese so cai (MISA export) with accounts 511, 632, 641, 642, 911. Build the P&L.
evals.expected_output: Uses the VAS scheme; maps 511 revenue, 632 COGS, 641 selling, 642 G&A; excludes 911 closing entries and warns that closing entries zero out P&L accounts.
assertions: Selects the VAS chart-of-accounts scheme
Excludes or warns about 911 closing entries
Discloses any unmapped or keyword-mapped accounts
Handles Vietnamese headers and number formats (1.234.567,00)
